name: hakka-next-fullstack-example
description: Next.js App Router example showing server + client API calls in one Hakka inspector.
//overrides: The hakka-* packages aren't published yet, so direct deps use file: paths and the transitive pair (hakka-core, hakka-bridge) is overridden to the same directories. This example lives outside the root workspace on purpose (it must resolve like a real consumer, not through hoisted monorepo node_modules). Install with npm — bun lays file: deps out as per-file symlinks, and Turbopack rejects a symlinked package.json.
